posts.author: amitskale
posts.text: RBI tomorrow: 25 or 50 bps? Is the Fed forcing our hand again? — 50 bps is the right thing to do but looking at their pro govt stance they will do 25 bps and keep the commentary as well neutral when ideally it should be hawkish. I wouldn’t be surprised if they even don’t raise the rates at all tomorrow because they are in a denial mode all the time that inflation is higher and rather will have audacity to say that current inflation is supply side and that’s why rate increase is not warranted..

posts.author: Danny_Crespin
posts.text: RBI tomorrow: 25 or 50 bps? Is the Fed forcing our hand again? — MPC decision is out tomorrow at 10 am. Consensus is a 25 bps hike, taking repo to 5.50%. My view: the repo rate isn’t a tool to attract FIIs, but sometimes the RBI is forced to react to the Fed. US 10Y is above 5.2% and ours is at 7.21%, so the spread is only about 200 bps. That’s thin for anyone carrying rupee risk. Capital leaves, the rupee weakens, and with Brent still around $100 that feeds into inflation. We’ve seen this before.
